soak.head: 82d18a1662a3a4f3a371a9012e0b08b2fd6c980c
soak.scope: One real Edge/GPU expanse World at production assets/DPR. 600 product RAF lifecycle frames plus 6000 product RAF soak frames; extra setup/warm/expiry frames explicitly counted. Fixed advanceDays(.1) once per original product update is a controlled simulation schedule, not Native performance acceptance. UI input/save gates are covered by existing G1/G22/G23 browser tests.
soak.resourceScope: Corrected strict-warm-constant instrument to an exact finite-identity ledger, without tolerances or baseline resets: freeze all-scene inventory I0 and unique warm submissions R0; require GPU warm geometry count=|R0| and R0 subset I0. Every block preserves geometry/owner/material/capacity identities and shape, legal counts, no disposal, R0 subset Rt subset I0, and exact GPU geometry count=warm+|Rt\R0|. Already inventoried hidden geometry first use is normal recorded attribution; new UUID/identity/shape, missing or duplicate submissions, texture/program changes and any unexplained +/-1 count remain failures collected until 6000 frames finish. The original strict-constant failed proof stays historical and is not rewritten.
soak.instrumentationScope: Extra scene traversal, one-forward onBeforeRender wrappers and serialized geometry/dispose ledgers add CPU/allocation overhead. This is controlled stability attribution, not Native performance acceptance. WeakSets/WeakMaps track live objects; evidence maps store serializable values only.
